description.fallback: After staying within the shadow of Sethan, Malèna has been turned into a fetus and will die if Alessi remains undefeated. The four-year-old Polnareff grabs Malèna and tries running away from Alessi. Alessi summons his Sethan and attacks Polnareff, de-aging him even further.

intro.fallback: After staying within the shadow of Sethan, Malèna has been turned into a fetus and will die if Alessi remains undefeated.
The four-year-old Polnareff grabs Malèna and tries running away from Alessi.
Alessi summons his Sethan and attacks Polnareff, de-aging him even further.

outro.fallback: After getting his faced carved up, Alessi runs away, jumping through a window and into the street.
Alessi thinks he has escaped, but as he looks up he sees Jotaro standing before him.
